create_InferenceClient: create an InferenceClient instance with hf-inference provider and an API key from environment
run_feature_extraction: run feature extraction on a text string using the intfloat/multilingual-e5-large-instruct model
build_feature_extraction_pipeline: build a feature extraction pipeline by initializing InferenceClient and calling feature_extraction on input text
